title: Minecraft: New Nintendo 3DS Edition
shortDescription: A portable sandbox edition that lets players gather, build, explore, and define their own projects within a shared set of simple systems.
highlights: Building goals can be as open-ended or structured as the player prefers
Survival and creative play provide complementary ways to inhabit the world

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A New Nintendo 3DS-specific simulation and adventure addition that represents the limited exclusive library without padding it.
